# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: lists (spec 6.2/6.4). Aggregates ride mid-expression on either
# tier; only the wire's FINAL value refuses one. A fixture result is a scalar, so list
# results are observed through folds.

== a literal list sums
expr [1, 2, 3].sum()
want num 6

== an env list sums
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.sum()
want num 60

== average
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.avg()
want num 20

== max
env temps: list(num) = [10, 40, 30]
expr temps.max()
want num 40

== min
env temps: list(num) = [10, 40, 30]
expr temps.min()
want num 10

== length
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.length()
want num 3

== first
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.first()
want num 10

== last
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.last()
want num 30

== an empty literal sums to zero
expr [].sum()
want num 0

== first of an empty list is unknown
expr [].first()
want nil

== indexing
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps[1]
want num 20

== indexing out of range is unknown
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps[9]
want nil

== a computed index
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps[1 + 1]
want num 30

== contains
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.contains(20)
want bool true

== contains misses
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.contains(99)
want bool false

== indexOf
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.indexOf(20)
want num 1

== indexOf misses with -1
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.indexOf(99)
want num -1

== sort ascending
env temps: list(num) = [30, 10, 20]
expr temps.sort().join(",")
want text "10,20,30"

== sort text lexicographically
env names: list(text) = ["b", "c", "a"]
expr names.sort().join(",")
want text "a,b,c"

== reverse
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.reverse().join(",")
want text "30,20,10"

== slice
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20, 30, 40]
expr temps.slice(1, 3).join(",")
want text "20,30"

== join over text
env names: list(text) = ["jog", "head"]
expr names.join(" ")
want text "jog head"

== a gathered literal list
env a: num = 1
env b: num = 2
expr [a, b, a + b].join("-")
want text "1-2-3"

== sum over text refuses at compile
env names: list(text) = ["a", "b"]
expr names.sum()
error needs a list of numbers

== a mixed literal loses its element shape and refuses nothing at compile
expr [1, "a"].sum()
want nil

== the chain keeps the element shape
env temps: list(num) = [30, 10]
expr temps.sort().first() + 1
want num 11

== a list is one scalar short of the wire
tier wire
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20]
expr temps.sort()
error one scalar

== but a fold of one is wire-legal
tier wire
env temps: list(num) = [10, 20]
expr temps.max() + 1
want num 21

== indexing wants a number
env temps: list(num) = [10]
expr temps["a"]
error list index wants num

== only a list or a map indexes
expr (5)[0]
error only a list or a map can be indexed
